(2) Cesionar ANAF lookup fills 'M&T AUTOSERVICE SRL' and full address (JUD. SIBIU, MUN. SIBIU, STR. MASINISTILOR, NR.23). critical_code_review_comments: server.py cui_lookup: CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; works in FastAPI because middleware is applied at request time, but convention is to add middleware before include_router. Non-blocking.
cui_lookup rejects <2 digit input as 422 which is correct; for well-formed but unknown CUI ANAF returns empty 'found' array -> mapped to 404 'CUI negasit'. Verified with cui=12345678 returning 404.
PDF parsing is fully client-side per GDPR requirement; verified in browser DOM after set_input_files without any network call to backend for PDF content.
